# Introduction

The {{"template":"referral","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an item introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / lcc:0.5.1"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. It is a simple crafting material used to create {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:turbines","plural":"true"}}.

# Obtaining

{{"of":"self"}} is acquired by right-clicking a {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:lodestone"}} with an {{"of":"minecraft:item / minecraft:iron_ingot"}} in hand.

Each right click consumes 1 {{"of":"minecraft:item / minecraft:iron_ingot"}} and drops 1 {{"of":"self"}} on the ground.
